DRAFT sample. Most matrimonial profiles are honest. A few warning signs seen together are a good reason to slow down and ask for documents before anything is fixed.

:::callout{type="warning"}
Never send money to someone you have not met, whatever the reason given.
:::

## Which signs should make you pause?

- The profile photo looks like a stock image or a film still.
- The person avoids video calls but wants to move fast.
- Job details are vague, or the company cannot be found.
- Someone asks for money for a visa, a customs fee or a medical emergency.

## What should you ask instead?

Ask for a video call with family present. Ask for the offer letter and look the company up in the [MCA company register](https://www.mca.gov.in/). A genuine family will understand.

## What if you have already paid?

Report it on the [National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal](https://cybercrime.gov.in/) and call the 1930 helpline as soon as you can. Keep screenshots of every chat and payment.

:::msp-cta{placement="end"}
